notes: LanguageModelSession.SessionProperty conforms to Sendable only where Value: Sendable (FoundationModels.swiftinterface, MacOSX27.0.sdk). Apple's documentation data lists the conformance without the condition. An unconditional Sendable conformance on a generic wrapper fails in Swift 6 mode. Swift 5 mode does not diagnose the missing conformance, so this case needs -swift-version 6.
